column2: कोरेगाव पार्कमध्ये लेन सातमधल्या सोसायटीच्या गेटजवळ सांडपाण्याची लाईन गळतेय. प्रवासी उतरताना त्या पाण्यात पाय पडतो.
Koregaon Park lane 7 mein hamari society ke gate ke paas sewage line leak ho rahi hai. Members ki taraf se request hai ki jaldi repair karwaaiye.
कोरेगाँव पार्क लेन सात में सोसाइटी गेट के पास सीवेज लाइन लीक है। डिलीवरी के लिए उसी गंदे पानी से होकर जाना पड़ता है, बीमारी का डर है।

A water main burst on the Vadgaon Budruk main road yesterday and water has been gushing out ever since. The road is flooded, my bike slid twice, and meanwhile the houses on this line have no water at all. I've called the helpline four times. Nobody has come. How is this acceptable?

Vadgaon Budruk main road var kaal pipeline futli ani ajun paani vahtay. Aamhi vruddha lok ithun chalayla ghabarto, rasta ola ani ghasarda. Gharat matra paani nahi. Complaint dili pan koni aala nahi, it's really tiring. Krupaya lavkar repair kara.

Vadgaon Budruk chya mukhya rastyavar kaal pasun pipeline futli aahe ani paani sarkhe vahat aahe. Bike varun jatana chaak ghasarte, bhiti vatate. Tyach veli aamchya gharat nalala paani nahi. Itka paani vaaya jatay ani aamhi bucket sathi fir-fir karto. Lavkar durusti karavi.
जेएम रोड के पास हमारे घर में पानी का दबाव बहुत कम है। कृपया लाइन की जाँच करवाइए।
Water pressure in our JM Road building is very low. At my age carrying buckets is difficult.

JM Road ke paas hamari building mein water pressure bahut kam hai. Subah office jaane se pehle nahaane ke liye bhi paani nahi hota. Motor lagao toh neeche walon ka paani ruk jaata hai. Please ek baar main line check karwa dijiye, bahut request hai.
Pashan la pavsanantar khadde padle, bhiti vatate.
पाषाणला पावसानंतर रस्त्यावर खड्डे पडलेत.
Pashan mein baarish ke baad main road pe kaafi saare gaddhe ho gaye hain. Bachchon ko school chhodne jaate waqt scooter unme uchhalta hai. Kripya jaldi bharwa dijiye.

Karve Nagar mein hamari society ke kone pe kachre ka dher roz badhta ja raha hai. Garbage van aati hai, sirf dibba khaali karti hai aur baaki kachra waise hi chhod deti hai. Members har din complain karte hain. Please is corner ko poori tarah saaf karwaiye.
कर्वेनगरच्या कोपऱ्यावरचा कचऱ्याचा ढीग आता इतका जुना झालाय की त्याला पुरातन वास्तूचा दर्जा द्यावा.
कर्वेनगरमध्ये society च्या कोपऱ्यावर कचऱ्याचा ढीग रोज वाढतोय. Office ला जाताना रोज त्या वासातून जावं लागतं. Van येते, dustbin रिकामा करते, बाकी तसंच. Please पूर्ण cleaning करा.
सेनापती बापट रस्त्यावर झाडाची मोठी फांदी पडलीय, दोन दिवस झाले, कोणी आलं नाही!
S B Road pe badi daal giri padi hai, rickshaw nikalne ki jagah nahi.

A big branch came down on Senapati Bapat Road near the bus stop two days ago and is still blocking half the lane. I ride through there dozens of times a day on deliveries. Could the tree department please clear it?
पाषाण का service road पूरा टूटा है, बच्चों की school bus अंदर नहीं आती. Kab ठीक होगा?
The service road in Pashan is completely broken up. My delivery bike takes a beating every single trip.
Pashan ka service road toota hai, kripya theek karwaiye.
NIBM Road var footpath var zadachi mula baher aali aahet. Mulanna shalet nyayla tithun jaave lagte, they keep tripping. Please durusti kara.
Tree roots have broken the NIBM Road footpath. Please fix.
NIBM Road pe ped ki jadon ne footpath ki tiles tod di hain. Bike park karke chalo toh pair atak jaata hai, frustrating yaar.
Our tap water in Dhankawadi has been coming out yellow for a week. I've stopped drinking it and I'm tired of buying bottles.

Dhankawadi madhe aamchya dukanat nalatun gelya aathvadyapasun pivla paani yetay. Tyat barik mati pan aste. Chaha, sarbat sathi paani vikat ghyava lagta. Customers pan vicharat hote. Krupaya paanyachi tapasani karun kay karan aahe te sanga.
Dhankawadi la hostel madhe nalatun pivla paani yetay. Aamhi sagle students bottle cha paani ghetoy, pan roj shakya nahi. Pipeline madhe kahi problem asel, kindly tapasani karavi. Tumche aabhar.
Erandwane mein kachre wale bhaiya segregation nahi hone pe thaili chhod jaate hain. Hum koshish karte hain, please thoda samjha dijiye.

Erandwane madhe kachra gheun janare ola-suka vegla nasel tar pishvi ghetach nahit. Mi delivery madhe aslyamule kadhi kadhi chuk hote. Mag teen divas pishvi daraat padun rahate ani kutri yetat. Niyam neet samjava.
Erandwane la ola suka mhanun kachra nahi nela. Great customer service.
मगरपट्ट्यातल्या नवीन रस्त्यावर एकही दिवा नाही! रात्री एकटीने चालताना भीती वाटते!
Magarpatta navin road var lights ch nahit! Mulanna ghevun kasa jaaycha?
Magarpatta cha navin rasta tayar zala, pan ajun dive basvle nahit. Raatri pravashi sodtana khup andhar asto. Krupaya lavkar dive basvave.
Warje madhe paani fakt 10 minit yeta! Dukan chalvaycha kasa?
वारजे में पानी सिर्फ़ दस मिनट आता है। इतने में न नहाना होता है न खाना बनता है। रोज़ सुबह ऑफिस के लिए निकलने से पहले यही जंग। कई बार शिकायत की, कोई फ़र्क नहीं। कृपया आपूर्ति का समय बढ़ाइए।
Warje mein paani 10 minute ka guest appearance deta hai, bas.
Balewadi cha footpath zadachya mulanni itka ukhadla aahe ki tyala ata 'nature trail' mhanava. Office la jatana roj trekking.
Balewadi mein ped ki jadon ne footpath poora tod diya, dukaan ke saamne log girte hain! Koi theek karega?
Tree roots have cracked the Balewadi footpath badly. I park my bike and trip on it every day.

FC Road near the college gate has no proper footpath on one side. Every evening I walk home that way and have to squeeze between parked cars and moving traffic. It's frustrating that a road this busy doesn't have a basic footpath. Please build one.
FC Road वर college gate जवळ एका बाजूला footpath च नाही. प्रवासी उतरल्यावर थेट traffic मध्ये उभे राहतात. Please footpath बांधा.
FC Road पे college gate के पास footpath नहीं है. Customers road पे खड़े होकर shop में आते हैं.
बाणेरच्या मुख्य रस्त्यावर लेनच्या रेषा पुसून गेल्या आहेत. सोसायटीचे सदस्य रोज तक्रार करतात की वाहनं कशीही येतात.
Baner main road var lane chya resha disat nahit. Krupaya punha rangva.
Baner road var lane marking gayab, raatri scary.

Yerawada mein kachra lene wale gila-sukha alag na ho to thaili le jaate hi nahi. Main roz subah jaldi nikalta hoon, kabhi galti ho jaati hai. Phir do din thaili bahar padi rehti hai. Kripya niyam samjhaaiye aur thodi narmi rakhiye.
Yerawada collectors refuse bags over tiny segregation mistakes. Bags sit outside my door for days.

Yerawada madhe kachra gheun janare ola-suka thoda pan mix asel tar pishvi taktat ani jatat. Aamhi prayatna karto! Pan mag teen divas daraat kachra, kutri ani vaas. Ha kasla niyam? Aadhi samjava, mag shikshya kara.

Swargate bus stand ke paas naya speed breaker bana hai, lekin uspe koi rang nahi hai. Raat ko commute karte waqt bikes uspe se udti hain, maine teen log girte dekhe. Could you please paint it and put a warning board? It would really help.
स्वारगेटजवळच्या नवीन गतिरोधकाला रंगच नाही! रोज अपघात होतायत!

Swargate bus stand javal navin speed breaker la rang nahi. Aamhi jeshtha nagrik rickshaw madhe basto tevha jor-daar dhakka basto. Bike vale pan raatri udtat. Krupaya lavkar pandhre-pivle patte mara ani ek board pan lava.
NIBM Road var footpath achanak sampto, delivery sathi chalat jatana pudhe rastyavar utarava lagta.
एनआयबीएम रोडवरचा फुटपाथ मधेच संपतो, कृपया पुढे बांधा.
The NIBM Road footpath just ends and drops you into traffic. Why?
कोथरूड में कचरा गाड़ी चार दिन से नहीं आई। हॉस्टल के बाहर थैलियों का ढेर लग गया है।
Kothrud mein kachre ki gaadi kaafi dino se nahi aayi. Kripya bhej dijiye.
Kothrud madhe garbage van gayab, legend zali.
The signal at the Undri junction blinks yellow all night. Nobody knows who should stop.
Undri signal raatbhar pivla, please thik kara.
Undri chowk pe raat bhar peeli batti hi jalti rehti hai. Kripya signal theek karwaiye, bahut confusion hota hai.
सहकार नगर में खंभा झुका है।
Sahakar Nagar mein society ke bahar bijli ka khamba jhuk gaya hai. Teen hafte ho gaye complaint kiye, koi nahi aaya.
सहकारनगरमध्ये दिव्याचा खांब झुकलाय, कोणी बघणार का?
एफसी रोडजवळच्या मोकळ्या प्लॉटवर लोक कचरा टाकतात. डिलिव्हरीला जाताना रोज त्या वासातून जावं लागतं.
FC Road javalchya mokalya plot var lok kachra taktat. Roj bus pakadtana tyachya javalun jaava lagta, krupaya kaarvai kara.
Stop the garbage dumping on the empty plot near FC Road. Residents are fed up.
पर्वती में दुकानों का सामान फुटपाथ पर रखा है, चलने को जगह नहीं। बहुत गुस्सा आता है!
Parvati madhe dukanancha maal footpath var. Office la jatana rastyavarun chalava lagta, krupaya footpath mokla kara.
पर्वतीत दुकानदारांनी फुटपाथ पूर्णपणे व्यापला आहे. रात्री एकटीने चालताना रस्त्यावरून जावं लागतं, मागून गाड्या येतात!

Gokhale Nagar mein hamare hostel ke bahar wali streetlight pichhle do hafte se flicker kar rahi hai. Padhte waqt khidki se aankhon mein chubhti hai aur neend bhi nahi aati. Could you please replace the bulb? It's a small fix but it'd really help us.

Gokhale Nagar madhe aamchya office baher cha diva disco sarkha chalu-band hoto. Roj sandhyakali ithe party chalu aahe asa vatta. Ek bulb badalayla itka vel lagtoy ki ata diva pan kantalla asel. Krupaya lavkar badla.
गोखलेनगरमध्ये घरासमोरचा दिवा सतत लुकलुकतो. मुलं घाबरतात, कृपया बल्ब बदला.
Wadgaon Sheri madhe aamchya colony madhe bhatkya kutryancha tras vadhla aahe. Mulanna shalet sodtana te mage lagtat. Krupaya nirbijikaran karave.
वडगाँव शेरी में आवारा कुत्तों का झुंड कॉलेज जाते समय पीछे दौड़ता है। कृपया इस पर कुछ कदम उठाइए।
Stray dogs in Wadgaon Sheri keep chasing people on my way to office.
Deccan Gymkhana madhe footpath var bandhkamacha maal padlay. Delivery bag gheun rastyavarun chalava lagta, kantala aala.
Deccan Gymkhana mein ek building ka material footpath pe pada hai. Office jaate waqt road pe chalna padta hai.

A builder in Deccan Gymkhana has turned the entire footpath outside our building into a storage yard: sand, bricks, steel rods. We've complained to the ward office and to the builder directly. Nothing has changed in three weeks. Pedestrians, including elderly residents, now walk on a busy road. This is unacceptable.

Kharadi madhe kaal raatri vadalat mothi fandi aamchya society chya gate samor padli. Sakali gaadya baher kadhta aalya nahit, members office la ushira gele. Tree department la phone kela, te mhantat 'list madhe aahe'. List kiti lamb aahe? Lavkar uchla.
Kharadi la mothi fandi rastyavar padli aahe, bike ghalta yet nahi. Raatri disat nahi, bhiti vatate.
Kharadi road pe tree branch giri hai, walk karna mushkil.

Dhayari madhe metro chya kamamule rasta ekdam ukhadla aahe. Aamhi vruddha lok davakhanyat jatana riksha itki hadarte ki paath dukhte. Kaam chalu astana tari tatpurti durusti karavi. Kiti mahine asach sahan karaycha?
Metro work has wrecked the Dhayari road. Walking home is exhausting.

Dhayari mein metro ke kaam ki wajah se road poori tarah toot gaya hai. Bachchon ko school le jaate waqt scooter itna uchhalta hai ki darr lagta hai. Kaam chalu hai samajh aata hai, par kam se kam temporary patch toh lagaaiye. Kripya dhyan dijiye.
Kondhwa ka nala kachre se bhara hai, baarish mein paani road pe aayega. Raat ko wahi raasta hai mera.
कोंढव्याचा नाला कचऱ्याने पूर्ण भरलाय. ऑफिसला जाताना रोज वास येतो, पावसाआधी सफाई करा.
Kondhwa nala full choke hai, pichhle monsoon mein rickshaw stand doob gaya tha. Please saaf karwao.
Someone burns garbage every evening near our Balewadi society. Members are concerned about the smoke.
Balewadi mein roz shaam ko koi kachra jalata hai, commute se aate waqt poora dhuaan. Seriously, kab rukega?
Balewadi madhe roj sandhyakali konitari kachra jaltay. Mulanna khokla lagla aahe, please he thambva.
विमान नगर में हमारी गली का लैंप टूटा पड़ा है। रात को अकेले लौटते समय बहुत डर लगता है, कृपया जल्दी ठीक करवाइए।
Viman Nagar madhe hostel baher cha lamp phutla aahe, raatri library varun yetana andhar. Kaach pan rastyavar padli aahe.
Viman Nagar madhe aamchya galli cha diva phutla aahe. Aamhi vruddha lok sandhyakali baher padto tevha kahi disat nahi. Krupaya navin diva lava.
A dead dog has been lying on the Kasba Peth road for two days. Apparently it's now a permanent feature.

Kasba Peth mein ek mara hua kutta do din se sadak pe pada hai. Lagta hai corporation use smarak banana chahta hai. Badboo itni hai ki subah walk pe jaana band. Hum buzurg log naak pe rumaal rakh ke kab tak chalein?
Kasba Peth madhe rastyavar mela kutra don divas padla aahe. Mi roj sandhyakali eklich tithun chalat jate, vaas itka ki shwas ghyayla pan tras. Mashya ani kavle jamlet. Krupaya lavkar uchla.
खराड़ी में सोसाइटी टैंकर पर, थक गए।

Kharadi mein hamari society teen hafte se tanker pe chal rahi hai. Is umar mein roz tanker wale ka intezaar karna, bucket bharna, bahut thaka deta hai. Municipal supply kab normal hogi, koi batata hi nahi. Please kuch update toh dijiye.
Our Kharadi society has depended on tankers for three weeks. Could we get an update on municipal supply?
Sutarwadi madhe aamchya galli madhe ek pan diva nahi. Krupaya lavkar dive lava.
Sutarwadi mein hamari gali mein saari lights band hain. Society ki taraf se nivedan hai ki jaldi theek karwaiye.

Our entire lane in Sutarwadi has been dark for over a week. My children come back from tuition along this lane and I have to walk out with a torch to meet them. Three complaints have been marked 'resolved' without anything changing. Please actually send someone.
Ghorpadi road pe gravel hi gravel, bike slip!

Ghorpadi mein patch work ke baad road pe itni loose gravel padi hai ki bikes roz slip hoti hain. Office jaate waqt maine teen accidents dekhe. Could someone please sweep the road properly? Bahut dhanyavaad.
Ghorpadi la khadi pasarli, gaadya ghasartat!
